description: The encrypted-ip module (opt-in build) for Google and two Prebid Server hosts (one with a port): a separate value for each, encrypted to each recipient's own key, and nothing for any of them under GPC. SID_MODULE_TIMEOUT_MS is 1000 so that a busy test machine's first Web Crypto call (about 15 ms cold on a laptop, against the default limit of 50) can't time out. Requests carry the client IP as both X-Forwarded-For (with SID_TRUST_PROXY) and CF-Connecting-IP (the Workers runtime). Every value is random (a fresh ephemeral key each time), so cases check its shape: unpadded base64url whose length gives 32 (enc) + the address's length + 16 (the AES-GCM tag) bytes: 192.0.2.77 is 10 characters, 58 bytes, 78 base64url characters; 2001:db8::abcd:0:0:1 (RFC 5952 form) is 20, 68 bytes, 91 characters. The keys are the recipient public keys (pkRm) of RFC 9180's published test vectors, for tests only: their private keys are public too. Prebid Server hosts here are single-label names (pbs-a, pbs-b) so that the dotted paths of jsonPatterns and jsonAbsent can name them.
